status: Revision for review: print one splice U and one splice plate, both solid. Unprinted; geometry checks only.
request: Make the splice stronger and beefier for a joint that flexes a lot: a thicker base, and one top plate in place of the two bars, closed by four screws and nuts at the corners, at the same size.

parent.checkpoint: US-TUBE-SPLICE-R001 (removed from the tree; in git history at commit 7dee43b)
parent.profile: Clamp U cross-section of US-NECK-MOUNT-R010 (designs/ultraskelly/src/enclosure.json, commit c49c6a1)
parent.fit_test: U1 (18.9 mm pocket), chosen by the user on the tube on 2026-11-03

changes_from_parent: U base 4 -> 8 mm; plate 8 mm (R001 bars 6 mm), head recesses 2.7 -> 4.7 mm deep so M2.5 x 16 still fits
One plate across the joint in place of two bars; four screws at the corners, 6 mm from the ends, in place of eight (R001 rows 5.25 mm either side of the joint)
U prints on its back (layers along the tube) in place of standing on one end
Both parts print at 100 % infill in place of 25 % gyroid
Length 60 mm and width 38.8 mm kept

parameters.splice.json: grip 30 per tube piece, base 8, plate 8, 3.3 under each head, holes end 2 below the pocket, row inset 6, screw 16
parameters.enclosure.json: tube and clamp sections: the U1 pocket, arms and M2.5 holes, nut slots and recesses

source.files: splice-u.stl and splice-plate.stl as exported by the build, byte for byte
source.images: rendered from the released files with part_images.py and part_titles.py, run generated/ultraskelly/part-images/splice-r002
source.section_comparison: R001's U rebuilt with splice.py and splice.json from commit 7dee43b and cut across the tube at the joint and at its two screw rows nearest the joint; R002's U and plate cut at the joint with splice.section. Disjoint outlines are summed about their common centroid.
source.commit: The commit that adds this checkpoint.

splice-u.stl.part: Splice U: U1 pocket (18.9 mm), 8 mm base, 60 mm long, four M2.5 captured-nut slots
splice-u.stl.orientation: On its back, pocket open upward; as exported.

splice-plate.stl.part: Splice plate, 8 mm thick, M2.5 hole and head recess at each corner
splice-plate.stl.orientation: Flat, screw-head recesses up; as exported.

estimate.method: Not sliced; the Snapmaker Orca command line crashed with the U1 profiles. Per part: side area x walls x 0.45 mm plus flat area x top/bottom layers x 0.2 mm, capped at the solid volume, plus infill in the rest; PETG at 1.27 g/cm3. Time at an average 6 to 10 mm3/s, as on a fast printer such as the U1.

hardware.use: Plate to U, one at each corner, into the captured nuts
hardware.check: validate() fits M2.5 screws from 13.9 to 21.8 mm across 18.0 to 18.6 mm tubes

hardware.item: M2.5 hex nut, 5.0 mm across flats, 2.0 mm thick (plain, not nylon-insert)
hardware.use: In the U side slots (5.4 by 2.6 mm)

buy.screws: M2.5 socket-head cap screws, 16 mm (at least 4)
buy.nuts: M2.5 hex nuts, 5.0 mm across flats (at least 4)

interfaces.tube: Square tube of 18.0 to 18.6 mm: 18.9 mm pocket, 0.3 to 0.9 mm of sideways play; the plate takes up both pieces front to back
interfaces.joint: Tube ends butt at z = 30, halfway along the U; the plate spans the joint
interfaces.matched_parts: The plate holes match this U only; print both from this checkpoint.

joint_sections.r001_bars_at_joint: none: the bars stop 0.25 mm either side of the joint

design_guidance.rule: FDM parts are weaker between layers; orient structural parts for their load.
design_guidance.change: U prints on its back and the plate flat, so bending at the joint runs along their layers; the screw clamping crosses the U layers (untested).

design_guidance.rule: Strength comes mostly from perimeters; most parts need 10 to 15 % infill, rarely over 30 %. A PETG hook held 110 kg at 100 % infill and 54 kg at 30 % with 3 perimeters.
design_guidance.change: 6 perimeters and 100 % infill, because the joint flexes.

design_guidance.rule: Walls thinner than one perimeter (about 0.45 mm) do not print.
design_guidance.change: At least three perimeters (1.35 mm) around every screw feature; see geometry_validation.walls_mm.

design_guidance.rule: Moving fits start at 0.3 mm clearance; vertical holes print undersized.
design_guidance.change: 2.9 mm clearance holes, all vertical as printed; U1 pocket 18.9 mm with 0.15 to 0.45 mm per side.

design_guidance.rule: Chamfers rather than fillets facing the bed; edges on the bed flare where fit matters.
design_guidance.change: Rounded corners only on edges vertical as printed; bed edges square; no fit surface touches the bed.

design_guidance.rule: Overhangs up to 45 degrees print without supports; bridges sag unless shorter than 5 mm.
design_guidance.change: Only the four nut-slot ceilings face down: 5.4 mm bridges, with 0.6 mm of slot over the nut for sag.
